nodes.klein: to go up, ascend. he went up, ascended; it sprang up, grew, shot forth; he rose, surpassed, excelled; was reckoned, was counted in, was considered. he succeeded, was successful. he immigrated to Israel (after Ez. 2:1 and 7:6). was brought up, was taken up, rose; was taken away. he brought up; he caused to rise; he caused to go up (on the altar; said of sacrifices); he promoted to a higher dignity; he put on, laid on. was brought up, was raised; was taken up into, was inserted; was offered (said of a sacrifice). he elevated, praised; he prized. (occurring only in the part. מֽעֻלֶּה (q.v.). he lifted himself up (in the Bible occurring only Jer. 51:3 in the form יִתֽעַל); was raised, was exalted; was raised in price.
